utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, Kira — I’m spreading the word about the repair drive, so come by if you can; it should be a good turnout!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, Quinn, am I supposed to bring tools or supplies for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: If you can, bring any tools or supplies you already have, but no worries if not — just come by and I’ll fill you in.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still checking with a couple people while I’m out, but I’ll let you know as soon as I pin down a time.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll keep telling folks the plan and I’ll wait for your update on the time.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate you spreading the word. I’m finishing a couple errands now, and I’ll let you know as soon as I’ve got the time pinned down.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Not yet, but I’m putting one together now. I’ll send out a clear time and list soon so we can keep it orderly.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good, Eli — just send it over when it’s ready, and I’ll keep an eye out for anything that still needs a hand.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Rey. I’ll keep it neat and send the time and list as soon as I’ve got them ready.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m still checking the basics—do you have the date, location, or supply list yet? Once I have those, I can organize the rest.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I don’t have all the details yet, but I can help once you send them—just keep it around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — I’ll keep it around the school schedule and wait for the date, location, and supply list before I organize anything else.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh right, the community center parking lot Saturday morning, with the labeled table by the front doors. I’ll plan to stop by then.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks Nell — just drop off any supplies at the labeled table by the front doors Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Perfect, I’ll do that Saturday morning. Thanks for confirming the drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: At the community center parking lot Saturday morning, by the labeled table near the front doors.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll pass along the community center parking lot Saturday morning, by the labeled table near the front doors. I’ll look for the supply list next.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — if you can keep an eye out for the supply list, that’d be a big help. Thanks for passing along the drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good — I’ll keep an eye out for anything we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Noah — if you hear of any gaps, let me know soon so we can plan around them.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Will do, Pia — I’ll let you know if I spot any gaps for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great — the community center parking lot by the front doors is set for Saturday morning around 10. Thanks, Leo, for helping keep the drop-off spot clear.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect, thanks, Opal — I’ll keep that spot clear and let the volunteers know to drop items there Saturday around 10.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, thanks, Leo — I appreciate you keeping that spot clear for Saturday around 10.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam. I’ll try to stop by if I’m up to it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: No worries, Uli — come by if you can, and take care of yourself.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam. I appreciate it—I’ll do my best to come by if I can.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Mina — I’ll keep everyone posted if the time or spot changes, but right now it’s still 10 to noon by the community center entrance.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, 10 to noon by the community center entrance works for me. I’ll plan to be there.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s wonderful, Mina — we could really use you there. I’ll let you know right away if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks, Cleo — I’ll try to swing by the repair drive and help out if I remember.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Oren — even a quick stop would help. I’ll keep the supply table ready for you at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, great — thanks, Cleo. I’ll do my best to stop by, and I appreciate you keeping the table ready.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Mara — if the repair drive needs any tools, I’ve got a few I can lend.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Gus — that’d be really helpful. I’m still planning on Saturday morning around 10, so I can take you up on that if we need anything.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Mara — just let me know what you need, and I’ll bring it over.
